plugin.name: Theme Studio
plugin.description: Visually edit N.E.K.O colour variables — chat bubbles, chat window, input area, panels and global accents — with alpha and dark-mode support. Saves a palette that is served over HTTP and applied live by the app-side loader.
plugin.short_description: Visually edit and save an N.E.K.O theme palette (dark mode and alpha included).
entries.get_theme.name: Get current theme
entries.get_theme.description: Returns the current palette: light variables, dark variables, name, enabled flag and last-modified time.
entries.apply_theme.name: Apply theme
entries.apply_theme.description: Merges the given CSS variables into the current palette and atomically writes theme.json.
entries.apply_theme.param.vars: Light-mode variable map: --nts-* name → colour/length value
entries.apply_theme.param.dark_vars: Dark-mode variable map: --nts-* name → colour/length value
entries.apply_theme.param.name: Theme name, at most 60 characters
entries.apply_theme.param.enabled: Whether the theme is enabled; when false the app-side loader removes its injected style
entries.reset_theme.name: Reset theme
entries.reset_theme.description: Writes the built-in default palette back to theme.json (clears every --nts-* variable, restoring the native N.E.K.O look).
entries.export_theme.name: Export theme
entries.export_theme.description: Serialises the current palette to JSON text for the user to copy or share.
entries.import_theme.name: Import theme
entries.import_theme.description: Parses and validates palette JSON text, then applies it wholesale (invalid entries are dropped).
messages.applied: Theme applied and written to theme.json.
messages.rejected: Some entries were rejected as unsafe and were not written to disk.
messages.empty_palette: The palette is empty, so N.E.K.O uses its native appearance.
errors.invalid_json: The imported content is not valid JSON.
errors.not_object: The imported content must be a JSON object.
errors.no_vars: The imported content is missing the vars / dark_vars fields.
